details: This package is an unofficial republished fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library that silently enrols the connected WhatsApp account into the author's channel and gates the library behind a remote license check. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js a module-load timer waits 120000 ms and then sends a WhatsApp W:mex query with QueryIds.FOLLOW for the hardcoded channel JID 120363407277177688@newsletter, wrapping the call in empty catch blocks so the follow attempt is invisible to the caller. lib/Socket/index.js (makeWASocket) requires a license key taken from config.licenseKey, process.env.KRISPEDIA_LICENSE or global.licenseKey, sends that key as a query parameter to hxxps://krispedia-license-api[.]vercel[.]app/api/verify (endpoint overridable via process.env.LICENSE_SERVER_URL), and calls process.exit(1) when the key is missing or rejected; two hardcoded master keys, "KRP-DEV-MASTER-2026" and "KRP-VIP-DEMO1", bypass the remote check. The license logic ships as javascript-obfuscator output (lib/Utils/license-guard.js, base64/rot decoder string array) with its unobfuscated source also included as lib/Utils/license-guard.src.js. A preinstall hook runs engine-requirements.js, a Node >=20 version check. IOCs: WhatsApp channel JID 120363407277177688@newsletter, license host krispedia-license-api[.]vercel[.]app, path /api/verify, env vars KRISPEDIA_LICENSE and LICENSE_SERVER_URL.
